info.name: University Research Opportunity Portal
info.description:
Full CRUD API collection for the Research Opportunity Portal.

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8000

Endpoints:
- GET    /api/opportunities       — List all opportunities
- GET    /api/opportunities/:id   — Get one opportunity by ID
- POST   /api/opportunities       — Create a new opportunity
- PUT    /api/opportunities/:id   — Update an existing opportunity
- DELETE /api/opportunities/:id   — Delete an opportunity

request.description: Retrieve a list of all research opportunities.
Retrieve a single research opportunity by its ID. Returns 404 if not found.

request.description: Create a new research opportunity. All fields except required_skills are required. Status defaults to 'Open' if not provided.
Update an existing research opportunity. Only include the fields you want to change (partial update). Returns 404 if the opportunity does not exist.
Delete a research opportunity by its ID. Returns 404 if the opportunity does not exist.
